description: Sensitivity analysis: including Arabidopsis complex I twin-CX9C subunits in the MIA40-dependent set, with summary figure
code:
import re, requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

RE_T3=re.compile(r"C.{3}C.{3,45}C.{3}C"); RE_T9=re.compile(r"C.{9}C.{3,45}C.{9}C")
def gs(a): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])

SETS = {
 "dependent":[("CSD1","P24704"),("CSD3","Q9FK60"),("CCS","Q9LD47"),("AIM1","Q9ZPI6"),("SLP2","Q944L7")],
 "dependent_CI":[("NDUFS5-A","O82238"),("NDUFS5-B","Q9LZI6"),("NDUFA8-A","Q9SQT4"),
                 ("NDUFA8-B","Q8LGE7"),("NDUFB7","Q9SKC9")],
 "independent":[("TIM8","Q9XGY4"),("TIM9","Q9XGX9"),("TIM10","Q9ZW33"),("TIM13","Q9XH48"),
                ("COX17-1","Q9LJQ9"),("COX17-2","Q94FT1"),("COX19-2","Q9C9L6"),
                ("CCMH","Q9XI46"),("AAC1","P31167")],
}
rows=[]
for lab,g in SETS.items():
    for nm,a in g:
        s=gs(a)
        rows.append(dict(set=lab,protein=nm,acc=a,L=len(s),n_cys=s.count("C"),
                         twinCX3C=bool(RE_T3.search(s)),twinCX9C=bool(RE_T9.search(s))))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows); D["any_twin"]=D.twinCX3C|D.twinCX9C
print(D.to_string(index=False))

def fish(depsets):
    d=D[D.set.isin(depsets)]; i=D[D.set=="independent"]
    a,b=int(d.any_twin.sum()),int((~d.any_twin).sum()); c,dd=int(i.any_twin.sum()),int((~i.any_twin).sum())
    return a,b,c,dd,fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,dd]])[1]

print("\n=== Rule: 'lacks twin CX3C/CX9C  =>  MIA40-dependent' ===")
a,b,c,dd,p=fish(["dependent"])
print(f"A) Dependent set excludes complex I subunits (n=5 vs 9): dep twin+ {a}/{a+b}, indep twin+ {c}/{c+dd}, "
      f"Fisher p={p:.4f}, accuracy={(b+c)/14:.3f}")
a2,b2,c2,d2,p2=fish(["dependent","dependent_CI"])
print(f"B) Dependent set includes the 5 complex I twin-CX9C subunits (n=10 vs 9): dep twin+ {a2}/{a2+b2}, "
      f"indep twin+ {c2}/{c2+d2}, Fisher p={p2:.4f}, accuracy={(b2+c2)/19:.3f}")
print("   -> adding complex I CHCH subunits collapses the rule to non-significance.")

# ---------- figure ----------
order = list(D.protein)
cols = {"dependent":"#B5495B","dependent_CI":"#E08A3C","independent":"#3C6E99"}
fig,axes = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13,6), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[2.1,1]})
ax=axes[0]
for k,(_,r) in enumerate(D.iterrows()):
    y=len(D)-k
    ax.hlines(y,0,1,color="#DDDDDD",lw=0.8)
    ax.scatter([0.18],[y],s=150,marker="s",color=cols[r.set])
    ax.scatter([0.45],[y],s=150,marker="o",
               color="#222222" if r.twinCX3C else "white",edgecolor="#222222",lw=1.2)
    ax.scatter([0.62],[y],s=150,marker="o",
               color="#222222" if r.twinCX9C else "white",edgecolor="#222222",lw=1.2)
    ax.text(0.80,y,str(r.n_cys),ha="center",va="center",fontsize=10)
    ax.text(0.15,y,"",)
    ax.text(0.13,y,r.protein,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(-0.25,0.95); ax.set_ylim(0.3,len(D)+0.9)
for x,lab in [(0.18,"set"),(0.45,"twin\nCX3C"),(0.62,"twin\nCX9C"),(0.80,"n Cys")]:
    ax.text(x,len(D)+0.7,lab,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=10,fontweight="bold")
ax.axis("off")
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
ax.legend(handles=[Line2D([],[],marker="s",ls="",color=cols[k],label=l) for k,l in
                   [("dependent","MIA40-dependent (non-complex I)"),
                    ("dependent_CI","MIA40-dependent: complex I CHCH subunits"),
                    ("independent","MIA40-independent")]],
          loc="lower left",bbox_to_anchor=(-0.22,-0.08),frameon=False,fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Cysteine motifs do not mark MIA40 dependence in Arabidopsis",fontsize=12,loc="left")

ax=axes[1]
labels=["excl. complex I\n(5 vs 9)","incl. complex I\nCHCH subunits\n(10 vs 9)"]
pv=[p,p2]; acc=[(b+c)/14,(b2+c2)/19]
xs=np.arange(2)
ax.bar(xs-0.18,[-np.log10(v) for v in pv],0.34,color="#B5495B",label="-log10 Fisher p")
ax.bar(xs+0.18,[a*3 for a in acc],0.34,color="#3C6E99",label="accuracy x 3")
ax.axhline(-np.log10(0.05),ls="--",color="#555555",lw=1)
ax.text(1.45,-np.log10(0.05)+0.04,"p = 0.05",fontsize=9,ha="right",color="#555555")
ax.axhline(-np.log10(0.005),ls=":",color="#555555",lw=1)
ax.text(1.45,-np.log10(0.005)+0.04,"Bonferroni (10 features)",fontsize=9,ha="right",color="#555555")
for i,(v,a_) in enumerate(zip(pv,acc)):
    ax.text(i-0.18,-np.log10(v)+0.05,f"p={v:.3f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
    ax.text(i+0.18,a_*3+0.05,f"{a_:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(xs); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=9); ax.set_ylabel("value")
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=9); ax.set_title("Rule: lacks twin motif = MIA40-dependent",fontsize=11,loc="left")
for sp in ("top","right"): ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
D.to_csv("mia40_sensitivity_table.csv",index=False)
